prompt: Frankie calls the big parade downtown
title: Big Parade
irony: Frankie's loud calls to show Teddy each float pull his eyes to her porch, so he sees the parade only when she stops calling and marches beside him.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning light fills the street as Teddy names each flag while drums sound near the corner.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy clutches fact cards at the curb and wants the front spot to name each float, scared to march unread.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Frankie booms the call from her porch and Knox dares Teddy to race for the rail as drums roll past.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The crowd chants the parade chant as flags wave and Teddy spins toward Frankie's voice.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Teddy corrects each call with Actually facts and loses sight of the floats while Benny trusts Knox's tall tale.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Cards fly at the rail as Benny gives his front spot away and both kids face the wrong way laughing.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The chant rises again as the big drum turns the corner and Teddy still watches the porch.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Frankie holds the quiet mic and sees her loud calls pull eyes from the street to her porch.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Frankie drops the score card and chooses to watch this moment beside Benny in the warm sun.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Frankie sings the turned line beside Teddy as Knox shares the rail and the floats roll close.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Teddy marches beside Frankie naming floats from memory as Benny waves flags with Knox.
